reddit_quotes: I've used Wolverine 1000 Mile for 11 months. Not worth the premium.
Wolverine 1000 Mile is the kind of thing you don't appreciate until you've used the cheap alternative and regretted it.
The Wolverine 1000 Mile community is split, but the people who actually own them tend to keep them.
detractor_quote: I returned my Wolverine 1000 Mile after two weeks. The QC was terrible.
